Meet people who've been exactly where you've been. Learn from their testimonies and their stories. Build real life lasting friendships. Find subcontracting opportunities. Find people who can subcontract for you. Find commercial cleaning opportunities. Find residential cleaning opportunities. Whatever you're looking for is going to be in this building right here. You do not want to miss it. So again, make sure you visit www.cbnconference.com and get your tickets today before they sell out. See you this October in Jacksonville. Talk to you soon.

items.caption:
Everyone wants the fast way.

The fastest marketing strategy. The fastest way to get clients. The fastest way to make six figures.

But being busy doesn't mean you're building a successful business.

Real growth comes from doing the right things consistently. There are no shortcuts—only better strategies, better systems, and better people to learn from.

That's why the CBN Conference exists. If you're ready to stop chasing shortcuts and start building a real cleaning business, see you there.
items.transcript: I think we've confused being busy with actually making progress. Everything today is faster. You got fast food, fast internet, you got fast shopping, you got fast money, fast success. And now, AI can answer your questions in five seconds. Everybody chat GPT, chat GPT. But here's what AI can't do, baby. It can't build your discipline. It can't make you keep your word to yourself. It can't make you knock on one more door after hearing 10 nos. It can't make you wake up out of bed when you don't feel like it. We've become so obsessed with shortcuts. That's the truth. Everybody wants passive income before they've even earned active income. Everybody wants automation before they've even built a business worth automating. Everybody wants freedom without first becoming responsible. And I think that's why so many people are frustrated. We're trying to speed up a process that's supposed to change us, who we are. I don't think entrepreneurship is just about making money. I think entrepreneurship is God's way of introducing you to the person that you're supposed to become. Because money doesn't change you. Money exposes who you are. Just think about it. If you're disciplined with $100, you'll probably be disciplined with a million dollars. And if you're irresponsible with $100, a million dollars is just going to be a bigger headache for you. The business isn't the lesson. You are. It's you. You know why? Because you got to run the damn business. Maybe success was never taken too long. Maybe it just takes longer than our generation is willing to wait for. Maybe the reason why success is taking so long is because success isn't building your business. It's building you.

items.caption:
Success isn't just about working harder. It's about being in the right environment.

If you want to grow your cleaning business, surround yourself with people who think bigger, have done it before, and will challenge you to level up.

The CBN Conference is where growth happens.

Comment "LET'S GO" and we'll send you the details.
items.transcript: If you own a cleaning business in 2026, listen up. Come here. Let me holler at you for a minute. The reason why your cleaning business is not growing is because of your circle, okay? Just hear me out, because I know you already heard this before, but just hear me out. If I take a seed and I put that seed on some concrete, that seed is not going to grow. Why? Because it's in the wrong environment. If I take that same seed and I put it in the ocean, it ain't going to grow. Why? It's in the wrong environment. I take that same seed and I put some soil on it. I put some water on it. I start putting wind on it, sunlight. Chances are that seed is going to grow into the oak tree that God said it should be, right? But a lot of y'all are in the wrong environments. That's why you're not growing, y'all. That's why you're not growing. That's why I'm proud to say I'm so happy. AJ Simmons decided to do another conference this year. He said he wasn't going to do it for the cleaning industry, but he decided to do another conference. So October the 8th and October 9th, be in the building at the CBN conference, y'all. We're going to be there. Tenacity Academy is definitely going to be at this conference. I'm going to have my pen, my pad taking notes because guess what? I understand being in the right environment. Your environment is your nutrients. It's going to pour into you to help you become the entrepreneur you need to be to succeed. I'll see y'all at the conference, y'all. I'm tired. I'll see y'all at the conference.

items.caption:
Baby...

You can always make more money.

You can't make more time.

That's why I stopped chasing busy and started building systems, setting boundaries, and protecting my calendar.

Money comes and goes.

Time with your family.
Time with your health.
Time to enjoy the life you've worked so hard to build.

You don't get that back.

Build a business that gives you more than a paycheck.

Build one that gives you your time back.
items.transcript: You know, every morning you wake up to chase this right here. Every morning we wake up, we get out of bed to chase a piece of paper. This is a piece of paper, but we get up and we chase it faithfully every single day. You know what the funny thing is about this right here? You can't take it with you when you die. When you die, this right here goes to somebody else and somebody else gonna spend it. This is a piece of paper. Soon as you can realize how valuable your time is, because your time is the one thing on this earth that you can't get back. You can get this back. You can always make some more of this. If this burn up in the house, you can go get a job. You can get some more of this right here. But guess what? The one thing you can't get back is your goddamn time. That's why you need to stop letting people play with your time. Stop letting people play with your time. That's the one thing I can't get back. I can't get back an hour ago. It's gone. That hour's gone. It ain't never coming back. And we ain't never getting no younger. Especially if you're in your 40s right now. You're in your 40s, 50s. We at an age that we ain't really got time to play. We don't got no more time left to play on this earth. You know what the value of a dollar is nowadays? We over here crying, stressing, sacrificing our health over something that ain't even real in the sense that you think it is. There was a time when the US dollar was actually backed by gold. If you had a dollar, it represents something tangible sitting in a vault. But today, that's no longer how it works, baby. Nowadays, it's backed largely by confidence. Confidence that people will accept it tomorrow. Confidence that businesses will take it. Confidence that the government will honor it. Just think about it. People spend their entire lives chasing a piece of paper or some numbers on a screen. They miss birthdays. They miss vacations. They miss their kids growing up right before their eyes because they're staying at these toxic jobs chasing this shit right here. They stay on toxic jobs. They stay in unhealthy relationships because they're afraid of losing something that only has value because we said it does. Money isn't food. Money isn't water. Money isn't love. Money isn't time. Money is a tool. And the people who seem to have the most of it seem to understand that better than everybody else. They don't worship money. They learn how the system works. They buy assets. They invest. They build businesses. They create value. They make money work for them instead of working their whole entire life for some money. The biggest shift you could make isn't trying to get more money. It's actually understanding how to play the game. Don't spend your life chasing money. Spend your life becoming more valuable so that money naturally chases you.

👇 Type "CBN" in the comments if you'd like to attend the conference, and I'll personally send you the ticket link! Looking forward to seeing you in Jacksonville! 🎉
items.transcript: We are celebrating the cleaning industry October 8th and 9th. Because as a cleaning business owner, we work damn hard all year. Chasing clients, driving across town to do a walkthrough just to not get the contract. Hiring cleaners just for them not to do a good job. Then the client don't want to pay, but the cleaner still wants to get paid. So you end up paying the cleaner just to avoid conflict. And now you got to go do what she was supposed to do. And the client still leaves you a bad review. Welcome to the cleaning industry. We deal with late invoices. We deal with managing cash flow, training workers, building systems, learning CRMs, learning AI. We just trying to keep up. And now it's time to celebrate. October 8th and 9th, we celebrate the cleaning industry. Why? Because we matter. We are responsible for the clean bathroom stalls in public areas. We keep restaurants sanitized and clean. Ain't nobody trying to eat in no nasty restaurant. We keep hospitals safe. We keep offices running. We keep homes livable for families who don't have time to do it themselves. This industry runs on us. And it's time we stood on that. The Clean Biz Network Conference, October 8th and 9th, Jacksonville, Florida. Come learn, come laugh, come network with people who get it. This is family, baby. Click the link down below and I'll see you on the other side.

Listen, we've helped hundreds of cleaning business owners. And you know what I noticed? Sometimes it's not even all about your pricing. It's about your language. And these five little phrases will make you sound unsure even when you know what to do. One, I think. I think it'll be around 300. Baby, don't guess. You could say something like, let me ask you a few questions. That way I can give you an accurate estimate. See, there's a difference between being honest and uncertain. Number two, if that's okay with you, nah, we can't talk like that. If that's okay, you may say, we could come Friday morning if that's okay with you. But then you're shrinking yourself. Instead say, we have an opening Friday morning at 10 a.m. You want to be able to lead the conversation. People trust professionals who sound like professionals, period. Number three, I promise. Oh, I promise we'll do a good job. Promise? Child, you don't got to convince people with a promise. Convince them with proof. Show them your reviews. Show them your before and after pictures. Show them your systems. Promises fade. Proof sells. Number four, just. What do you mean just? We're just a small business or we're just doing a basic cleaning? Every time you say the word just, you're making yourself look and sound smaller. Take that word out and look how much more you look stronger. And number five, probably. It'll probably be around three hours. Probably? That tells the guests that you're guessing. If you really don't know, just say, based on what you told me, here's my estimate. There's confidence and then there's uncertainty dressed up as confidence. Don't mix the two. Clients are listening to your confidence before they're listening to your price. The way you speak tells them whether you're a beginner or a real cleaning business owner. And if you're ready to stop sounding like a beginner and start sounding like a real CEO, then meet me at the CBN conference this year, October 8th, October 9th. We're going to be in Jacksonville, Florida, baby. I will meet you there. See you on the other side.
